sites.description: Large demand sites of a known type, classified from the unified large-consumer register (Derived/demand_consumers, built by GDA from DNO embedded capacity registers, large demand lists and the TEC register). A site needs an import capacity to count. Rules are tried in order, specific before general (hospitals before universities, naval before port); names that mark a generation project (solar farm or park, wind farm, BESS) and place-name uses (School Farm, College Lane, Port Clarence) are excluded. Demand-shape fields are defined but empty until a source exists. profile_id is 'dem-' plus 16 hex of SHA-256 of source_key.

fields.name: profile_id
fields.description: Stable profile identifier (see the table description for its form).

fields.name: profile_rev
fields.description: Revision of this profile. It stays the same while the profile's content is unchanged and goes up by one when any value changes, so profile_id@profile_rev always means one fixed set of values.
fields.source: derived: previous build's revision and content_sha256

fields.name: content_sha256
fields.description: SHA-256 of the profile's values (every field except profile_rev, content_sha256 and last_updated_utc, floats by their exact bits). Used to decide when profile_rev goes up.

fields.name: source_dataset
fields.description: Lake dataset the row was built from.

fields.name: source_key
fields.description: The row's key in its source.

fields.name: last_updated_utc
fields.description: Profiles last updated: the date these profiles were brought up to.

fields.name: site_type
fields.description: Profiles folder under Demands (Hospitals, Schools, Universities, Colleges, Datacentres/Hyperscale (import 50 MW or more), Datacentres/SME (under 5 MW), Datacentres/Other, Datacentres/ByLocalAuthority (UKPN's per-local-authority totals: many sites summed, not banded), Port, Military/Land, Military/Naval).

fields.name: match_rule
fields.description: The classification rule that matched, as '<rule name>: <matched text>'. Rules are tried in a fixed order; the first match wins.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Customer or project name as published.

fields.name: site
fields.description: Site name as published.

fields.name: register_type

fields.name: energy_tech

fields.name: import_mw
fields.description: Site import capacity: the most the site may draw from the network.

fields.name: export_mw

fields.name: storage_mwh

fields.name: poc_voltage_kv
fields.description: Point of connection voltage.

fields.description: Grid supply point as published.

fields.name: bsp
fields.description: Bulk supply point as published.

fields.name: primary
fields.description: Primary substation as published.

fields.name: local_authority
fields.description: Local authority.

fields.name: easting
fields.description: OSGB easting in metres (British National Grid, EPSG:27700). Identifies the site, so sensitive.

fields.name: northing
fields.description: OSGB northing in metres (British National Grid, EPSG:27700). Identifies the site, so sensitive.

fields.name: postcode
fields.description: Postcode.

fields.name: connection_status
fields.description: Connection status as published (connected, accepted and so on).

fields.name: evidence_source
fields.description: Published register the row came from.

fields.name: base_load_mw
fields.description: [VERIFY] Typical steady demand. No source in the lake yet; reserved so the profile shape is fixed.

fields.name: peak_load_mw
fields.description: [VERIFY] Observed peak demand. No source in the lake yet; reserved so the profile shape is fixed.

fields.name: load_factor
fields.description: [VERIFY] Mean demand over peak demand. No source in the lake yet; reserved so the profile shape is fixed.

fields.name: fluctuation_band_pct
fields.description: [VERIFY] Typical short-term swing around the base load (datacentres: small). No source in the lake yet; reserved so the profile shape is fixed.

fields.name: ramp_up_mw_per_min
fields.description: [VERIFY] Fastest demand rise (datacentres: job start; ports: crane lift). No source in the lake yet; reserved so the profile shape is fixed.

fields.name: ramp_down_mw_per_min
fields.description: [VERIFY] Fastest demand fall. No source in the lake yet; reserved so the profile shape is fixed.

fields.name: power_factor
fields.description: [VERIFY] Typical power factor at the connection. No source in the lake yet; reserved so the profile shape is fixed.

fields.name: voltage_sag_pct
fields.description: [VERIFY] Voltage dip at the connection under the largest load step (ports: crane and shore-power steps). No source in the lake yet; reserved so the profile shape is fixed.

fields.name: shore_power_peak_mw
fields.description: [VERIFY] Ports: peak demand when ships connect to shore power. No source in the lake yet; reserved so the profile shape is fixed.

fields.name: shore_power_connections_per_week
fields.description: [VERIFY] Ports: ship shore-power connections per week. No source in the lake yet; reserved so the profile shape is fixed.

fields.name: crane_peak_mw
fields.description: [VERIFY] Ports: peak demand of one crane lift. No source in the lake yet; reserved so the profile shape is fixed.

fields.name: crane_cycle_s
fields.description: [VERIFY] Ports: duration of one crane duty cycle. No source in the lake yet; reserved so the profile shape is fixed.

fields.name: named_operator
fields.description: [VERIFY] Operator or owner of the asset, from Demands/names.csv (named by hand, not published). Null where not named.

fields.name: named_site
fields.description: [VERIFY] Site name, from Demands/names.csv. Null where not named.

fields.name: named_address
fields.description: [VERIFY] Site address, from Demands/names.csv. Null where not named.

fields.name: named_by
fields.description: [VERIFY] Who named the asset and when, from Demands/names.csv.

fields.name: quality_flags
fields.description: Semicolon list of issues (for example no_poc_voltage). Empty when none.

Filed under Demands/LoadCentres/<voltage class>. profile_id is 'load-' plus 16 hex of SHA-256 of source_key.

fields.name: base_year

fields.name: peak_demand_reported

fields.name: demand_unit
fields.description: Unit of peak_demand_reported and the forecasts: MW (UKPN, NGED) or MVA (NPG).

fields.name: peak_demand_mw
fields.description: Observed maximum demand in MW (NPG: MVA x power factor).

fields.name: peak_demand_mva
fields.description: Observed maximum demand in MVA (UKPN, NGED: MW / power factor).

fields.name: forecast_y1

fields.name: forecast_y2
fields.description: Operator's forecast for base year + 2, in demand_unit.

fields.name: forecast_y3

fields.name: forecast_y4

fields.name: firm_capacity_reported

fields.description: Unit of firm_capacity_reported: MW (UKPN), MVA (NPG) or unknown (NGED does not state it).

fields.name: headroom_pct

fields.name: min_load_scaling_pct

fields.name: min_load_mva

datacentre_profiles.description: Half-hourly demand shape of each data centre in UKPN's Data Centre Demand Profiles (anonymised as 'Data Centre #N'), over each site's latest 365 days up to the last-updated date: base, median and peak utilisation, load factor, fluctuation band and half-hourly ramps, all as fractions of the site's capacity. Filed under Demands/Datacentres/Profiles.

fields.name: profile_id
fields.description: Stable identifier: 'dc-ukpn-' plus the anonymised number, two digits (Data Centre #8 is dc-ukpn-08).

fields.name: profile_rev
fields.description: Revision of this profile. It stays the same while the profile's content is unchanged and goes up by one when any value changes, so profile_id@profile_rev always means one fixed set of values.
fields.source: derived: previous build's revision and content_sha256

fields.name: source_dataset
fields.description: Lake dataset the statistics come from.

fields.name: source_key
fields.description: UKPN's anonymised data centre name.

fields.name: last_updated_utc
fields.description: Profiles last updated: the date these profiles were brought up to.

fields.name: operator
fields.description: Network operator publishing the profile (ukpn).

fields.name: anonymised_name
fields.description: UKPN's anonymised name, for example 'Data Centre #8'. The key that site_names.csv names.

fields.name: dc_number
fields.description: The number in the anonymised name.

fields.name: dc_type
fields.description: Enterprise (one owner's own estate) or Co-located (space let to many customers).

fields.name: connection_level
fields.description: Voltage level of the import connection as published (Extra-High, High or Low Voltage Import).

fields.name: window_start_utc
fields.description: First reading in the statistics window (up to 365 days before window_end_utc).

fields.name: window_end_utc
fields.description: Last reading in the window: the newest on or before the last-updated date.

fields.name: n_readings
fields.description: Half-hourly readings in the window.

fields.name: utilisation_min
fields.description: Lowest half-hourly utilisation: demand as a fraction of the site's capacity.

fields.name: utilisation_p05
fields.description: 5th percentile of utilisation: the site's base load as a fraction of capacity.

fields.name: utilisation_p50
fields.description: Median utilisation.

fields.name: utilisation_p95
fields.description: 95th percentile of utilisation.

fields.name: utilisation_max
fields.description: Highest half-hourly utilisation: the site's peak as a fraction of capacity.

fields.name: utilisation_mean
fields.description: Mean utilisation.

fields.name: load_factor
fields.description: Mean over peak utilisation (1 is a perfectly flat load). Null when the peak is zero.

fields.name: fluctuation_band
fields.description: utilisation_p95 minus utilisation_p05: the normal swing, as a fraction of capacity.

fields.name: ramp_up_p99
fields.description: 99th percentile of the rise between consecutive half-hours, as a fraction of capacity per half-hour (only readings exactly 30 minutes apart).

fields.name: ramp_down_p99
fields.description: 99th percentile of the fall between consecutive half-hours, as a positive fraction of capacity per half-hour.

fields.name: ramp_up_max
fields.description: Largest rise between consecutive half-hours, as a fraction of capacity per half-hour.

fields.name: ramp_down_max
fields.description: Largest fall between consecutive half-hours, as a positive fraction of capacity per half-hour.
